managers.title: Hyper-Direct Pressing General

managers.name: Lionel Scaloni
managers.title: World Cup Champion

managers.name: Jose Mourinho

managers.bio: Pragmatic master of mind games, defensive resilience, and ruthless counter-punches.

managers.title: Tactical Prodigy

managers.name: Unai Emery
managers.title: European Cup Specialist

managers.name: Tiago Barreto
managers.title: Iberian Passmaster

managers.name: Kenji Takahashi
managers.title: Stamina & Discipline Guru

managers.name: Kwame Mensah

approaches.letter:
Dear Head Coach,

Under our newly announced ownership structure, Argentinos Juniors is preparing for an unprecedented era of investment. We want a dynamic, hungry head coach at the helm. We are pledging ₹13.1M in immediate transfer funding alongside an attractive personal compensation package of ₹3.55M per year.

approaches.letter:
Dear Head Coach,

Our club is currently at a critical crossroads. Following the dismissal of our previous manager, our board has identified you as the visionary coach capable of bringing discipline, tactical spine, and belief back to our dressing room. We are offering you a 4-year contract, ₹9.3M in squad reinforcement funds, and complete authority over tactical decisions.
